rules.name: Atypical Tank
rules.description: A Russian 1945 battlegroup can include a single 'Atypical' tank or assault gun, selected from the Tank or Specialist Support entries of any Russian army list, for the points and BR given, and can include any of its normal upgrades.  The Atypical tank cannot already be listed in this army list.

rules.name: Bed-Spring Armor
rules.description: Any Russian Tank (T-34, Sherman 'Emcha' or IS-2) can be upgraded with bed-spring armor.  A tank equipped with bed-spring armor reduces the penetration value of a Panzerfaust or Panzerschreck hit, from the side or top, by -1.
